title: The overhaul, all four parts: a Play tab, more room, smoother sound, new tricks
thisBuild: Play tab: Pads and the desk are one tab now. At its top, Pads, Keys and My Desk switch what it shows; it reopens on the one you used last.
The card under the pads is gone. Everything it did is in the pad's menu (hold still, then lift), now with Mute, Solo and Resample too. Clears are red, at the bottom.

Steps: one row per sound, the name on the left and its 16 steps beside it, so about twice as many fit. Hold a name, then lift, for mute, solo and the doctor. A red M or yellow S by the number shows it.
Padiano: one thin header (octave, Glide, XY, settings, close) and taller keys. Hold is on the dock and the keys bar; the pad filter is the dock's (tap MIX to aim it at a pad) or a desk piece.
Doctor: Trim, Shape, Effects and Tools tabs under a waveform that stays put.
Every clear (pad, loop, notes, moves, bar, song) shows Undo right in its message.
Locked shows a yellow edge round the screen. New messes start in C minor.
Loops can be 1, 2, 4 or 8 bars (the bars button in Steps). Longer copies what's there into the new bars; BAR 1 to 8 picks which one you see.
Swap two pads: hold one still until its outline turns yellow, then slide onto another pad and lift. Undo swaps them back.
My Desk: while arranging, rename the desk, Save a copy, or Delete it.
Messes show a little picture: the first 16 pads' colours and the first loop's steps.
Song: Share the song bounces it and opens your share sheet in one tap.
Settings: Pad buzz gives a short buzz on every pad hit (off to start; your phone's touch vibration needs to be on).
One top bar: Play, Stop, Rec, Undo, then tempo and where the music is in one button (tap it for tempo, swing and click). ☰ holds Messes, Settings, Redo and Notes for Claude.
Hush is gone. Press Stop, then Stop again: everything lets go (held notes, effects, filters).

The dock starts folded to a thin strip on the left. Tap it or swipe right to open it; ◀ at its bottom folds it. Repeat lives on the dock now: tap RPT, and tap the rate under it for 1/8, 1/16, 1/32 or an arp.
⚙ Settings is its own sheet now (view size, empty pads record, beat glow, in key only, how-to text). Messes keeps your files only.
How-to text shows once on each page the first time you open it, in teal. ? in the top bar brings it back.
Show chord on the Padiano: every note now lights its chord on the keys you can see. Before, only the lowest notes did, because the rest of the chord sat off screen.
Smoother sound: clicks, arpeggios and rolls no longer make the phone tidy up memory mid-sound, and the sound starts with a slightly bigger buffer.
watch: Play a busy mess for a minute and listen for clicks or gaps.
Press Stop twice while notes are held and effects are on: all of it should let go.
Carry a pad onto another, then try playing pads fast: a quick slide should never swap anything.
Make a loop 8 bars and play it through.
limits: The site plays 1 and 2 bar loops only; a 4 or 8 bar loop opened on the site plays its first bar.
Steps' Click to hear moved to the tempo sheet (tap the tempo button).
Touching a pad still plays it as it opens its menu; playing on touch is what keeps pads quick.
